svg.title: For the nonperiodic affine field associated to a linear jet, on a nonwrapping neighborhood this equals its constant curl. The signed clover average consequently has derivative equal to the jet’s positive- plane flux w. The period n > 20 ensures the clover neighborhood has the required affine-coordinate increments. Hence Qq(U(t))/t2 −→1 a,b qab⟨wa, wb⟩.
